title: 板壁短斜线
description: 剪纸中，短短的对角路线把脚点与手点组成清楚的层次。

art_direction.medium: colored pencil sports sketch with layered visible pencil marks
art_direction.scene: An original layered-paper illustration shows a fictional adult following a short diagonal route across a low slab panel. Pale blue footholds and large coral handholds form a readable staggered line; the climber steps sideways and slightly upward while both hands retain easy support. Keep the feet close to a thick uninterrupted padded floor and the hips naturally above the weighted shoe. Show a wide oblique scene with cut-paper wall planes and empty landing space extending beyond the route. Use visible fiber edges, shallow shadows, and opaque adult clothing. Make the movement composed and anatomically credible. Include no captions, brands, leaping, dangerous exposure, or portrait framing.
